title: Mesin Ais Lalu
subject: the driver of the ice resurfacing machine at a shopping-mall ice rink in Kuala Lumpur who clears the skaters off every two hours and crawls the machine round the rink at walking pace while forty teenagers wait at the gate
caption: Industrial hard techno, mid-2020s Kuala Lumpur warehouse style, with Malay vocals. A distorted rumble kick on every beat with a long saturated tail; metallic clang percussion like a spanner on steel; an overdriven acid 303 line squelching between two notes; white-noise risers before each drop; a crowd of voices shouting the answer lines. Dark warehouse mix, saturated low end, dry close vocal sitting on top. Male baritone, deadpan half-spoken announcer delivery that breaks into a shouted chant on the hook. 148 BPM, F minor. Deadpan, bossy and secretly proud. No pop chorus, no hardstyle reverse bass, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM build-and-drop festival vocal.
lyrics:
[Intro - rumble kick and clanging metal, acid line creeping in]

[Verse 1]
Pukul empat, loceng berbunyi
Semua keluar, jangan buat tak tahu
Budak baju merah, kasut sewa
Aku nampak kau pusing lagi satu

[Pre-Chorus]
Pintu pagar kanan, beratur tepi
Lampu kuning, enjin hidup

[Chorus]
Mesin ais lalu, mesin ais lalu
Lapan kilometer sejam, jangan tolak aku
Mesin ais lalu, mesin ais lalu
Ais licin macam cermin, tunggu sampai aku lalu

[Verse 2]
Empat puluh orang tunggu kat pintu
Ada yang rakam, ada yang mengeluh
Satu pusingan, dua pusingan
Air panas berasap belakang aku

[Pre-Chorus]
Jangan ketuk kaca, jangan jerit nama aku
Aku tak boleh laju, ni kerja halus

[Chorus]
Mesin ais lalu, mesin ais lalu
Lapan kilometer sejam, sabar sikit kau
Mesin ais lalu, mesin ais lalu
Bila aku keluar nanti, baru ais kau punya

[Bridge - kick drops out, acid line alone, then everything slams back]
Budak baju merah lambai kat aku
Aku angkat tangan sikit je

[Chorus]
Mesin ais lalu, mesin ais lalu
Pagar dah buka, pergilah kau
Mesin ais lalu, mesin ais dah lalu
Ais licin macam cermin, jangan kau jatuh dulu

[Outro - acid line and clang percussion, kick cuts dead]
